categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: planning and engineering design, urban operation, smart urban-rural (digital economy) business, and investment business. Planning and engineering design include land spatial planning, strategic planning, urban design, urban renewal, TOD comprehensive development, landscape planning, architectural design, and related consulting services. Urban operation focuses on integrated consulting, industrial planning, land resource consolidation, urban investment banking, REITs incubation, park operation, industrial park operation, future community operation, and smart city terminal products. The smart urban-rural business leverages AI, big data, spatial computing, and digital twin technologies to provide digital governance and industry empowerment solutions. Investment business involves strategic cooperation and equity investments to empower traditional planning and promote urban operation and smart urban-rural business development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including AI-generated content (AIGC), artificial intelligence large models, big data analytics, spatial computing, digital twin platforms, and cloud computing. It integrates these technologies into its planning and urban operation services, developing proprietary platforms such as 'City Leia' big data platform, CIM platform, 'Industry Brain', 'Park Universe' AIGC public service platform, and AI-assisted planning design tools. The company emphasizes 'action planning + operation consulting' methodology, combining theoretical innovation, technical R&D, and empirical analysis to produce actionable and adaptable urban planning solutions. It also develops AI-powered tools for urban renewal, spatial asset management, and real-time control detailed planning systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are government entities at various levels, platform companies, large development and construction enterprises, and industrial park operators. It serves clients involved in urban and rural development, infrastructure construction, urban renewal, smart city initiatives, and digital economy projects. The company also targets overseas markets through collaborations with large state-owned enterprises, providing planning and consulting services in countries such as Thailand, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan. Its services cater to urban planning, city operation, industrial development, and smart community management sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 33 provinces, municipalities, autonomous regions, and special administrative regions. It has established branches and subsidiaries in major cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, Guangzhou, Nanjing, Ningbo, Xi'an, Foshan, Huizhou, Zhongshan, Jinan, Zhengzhou, Guilin, Shijiazhuang, Wuhan, Qingdao, Xiamen, Chengdu, Chongqing, Kunming, Tianjin, and Hefei. Additionally, it has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and projects in Southeast Asia, Africa, and Central Asia, aiming to broaden its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the urban development supply chain, providing professional technical services including urban planning, engineering design, and consulting. It extends its role downstream by engaging in urban operation services, asset management, and investment activities that support the development, financing, and operation phases of urban projects. The company integrates planning, financing, engineering, and operation (P+F+EPC+O) to offer comprehensive lifecycle services, positioning itself as a full-service urban planning and operation solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on becoming a 'smart city planning and operation expert' by integrating AI and digital technologies into its services. It maintains high R&D investment, emphasizing AI large model development, AIGC applications, digital twin platforms, and smart urban renewal systems. Key R&D projects include industry cluster intelligent mapping, AI-assisted planning design systems, real-time control detailed planning platforms, and smart city operation ecosystems. The company also prioritizes the commercialization of AI-enabled products and expanding AI compute service capabilities, aiming to accelerate digital transformation and enhance competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through professional technical service fees from planning and engineering design projects, obtained via public tenders and direct client commissions. Additional revenue streams include consulting fees from urban operation services, sales and licensing of proprietary AI and digital platforms, and investment income from equity stakes in strategic projects and funds. The company also earns income from government subsidies, asset disposals, and financial asset management. It employs a mix of project-based billing, subscription or licensing for digital products, and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading national private urban planning and consulting firm with strong brand recognition and technical expertise. It ranks among the top in the industry with comprehensive qualifications and a broad geographic presence. Its competitors include other large state-owned and private urban planning and design firms in China. The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'action planning + operation consulting' approach, advanced AI and digital technology integration, and expanding urban operation and smart city business lines, aiming to lead the industry transformation towards digital and operational services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 319 million, a 34% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.3 million, reversing from a profit in 2023. The decline is attributed to market contraction in traditional planning services and ongoing investment in new urban operation and digital economy businesses which are still in the investment phase. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.22 billion with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 981 million. The company maintains significant R&D investment at over 14% of revenue, aiming for future growth through digital transformation and business diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering precise, actionable, and operable urban planning and operation solutions that integrate planning, financing, engineering, and operation services. Its unique value lies in combining traditional urban planning expertise with cutting-edge AI, big data, and digital twin technologies to enable smart city development and urban renewal. Proprietary AI-assisted design tools and comprehensive urban operation platforms enhance efficiency and innovation. The company’s extensive geographic coverage and strong brand reputation, coupled with its commitment to R&D and technology-driven services, differentiate it as a forward-looking, integrated urban planning and operation expert.
